do: Hold and release physical C3 (button 15) on the dry aux patch.
expect: Physical/logical key 15 and note 48; physical down/up events. No synth voice on aux.

do: Turn SW4 (encoder index 3) one step each way.

do: Send Glass Keys, then press and release C3 physically.
expect: Panel-owned note 48 voice, then release and voice stop.

do: Compare playing with polling running and paused.

do: Put `firmware/FORGE.bin` on the test card root as the **only** `.bin` file. On macOS also remove `._FORGE.bin` (`dot_clean -m /Volumes/CARD` or delete it); the bootloader loads the first `.bin` it finds and would reject that metadata file. Use the installed bootloader's normal SD update

do: `H status ...`

do: `H send presets/02-slap.json`, then `03-long-echo.json`, while audio plays
expect: Acknowledged; echoes change; no crash; time change glides in pitch

do: Turn knobs 1–4 (hardware SW4, SW1, SW2, SW3, in panel order) and volume SW6; `H status`
expect: Mix/time/feedback/level move in that knob order; level can mute. Note which physical knob is which

do: `H cc 85 127 --output "OUT"`, then `H cc 85 0`
expect: Wet fades out then back; dry still follows level

do: `H capture saved-aux.json ...`; send another preset; `H send saved-aux.json`

do: Unplug aux source. `H send presets/04-glass-keys.json ...`; play all 25 keys

do: `H note 60 --output "OUT"`; `H note 60 --velocity 30`

do: `H note 60 64 67 --zero-velocity-off`

do: Send `05-soft-pad.json`, `06-saw-bass.json`; turn SW5
expect: Audibly different; SW5 sweeps tone. Steal/retrigger should not click and triangle should be clean high up (both fixed in software). **Record any click, or aliasing on high saw/square notes — don't fix during session**

do: In the webapp, change waveform, ADSR, cutoff; Send

do: `H note 60 64 67 --sustain --hold 3`; while it sustains, play a CHOMPI key

do: `H note 69 --bend 8191 --hold 2`, then `--bend -8192`

do: `H send presets/07-warm-pad.json ...`; hold chords on the keys

do: `H send presets/08-acid-bass.json`; play overlapping notes low on the keys

do: With Acid Bass: `H cc 1 127 --output "OUT"`, hold a note, then `H cc 1 0`
expect: Mod wheel brings in a filter wobble; at 0 it stops

do: `H send presets/09-bell-keys.json`; play single notes

do: With a v3 patch: `H cc 71 110`, `H cc 91 110`; `H capture cc-test.json ...`

do: Webapp: load Soft Pad (v2), **Convert to v3 instrument**, Send

do: Send a v2 preset, then a v3 preset, while holding a note

do: 10 minutes: four-voice playing with delay and reverb, recalling presets (v1, v2 and v3), turning knobs, normal MIDI clock if you have it

do: `H status` at the end
expect: Peak CPU < 100% (fail at ≥100%; < 70% is the comfort target). Record average, peak, dropped, rejected

do: **Worst case:** reboot (resets peak), `H send presets/10-cpu-stress.json`, hold four keys for 1 minute, `H status`
expect: Record average and peak. If peak ≥ 70 %, set voices to 3 then 2 in the webapp, Send, repeat, and record each. This sets the v3 CPU budget

do: **Sampler worst case:** record a ≥ 5 s take (3.34), reboot is not needed but note the peak first, `H send presets/13-sampler-stress.json`, hold seven keys for 1 minute, `H status`
expect: Record average and peak. If peak ≥ 70 %, lower voices to 5 then 4 and repeat. Sample reads come from SDRAM, so this is the number the emulator cannot predict

do: Reboot; `H status`; resend a saved patch
expect: Boots to dry aux defaults; recall works
